blurb: Gallatin Marina provides secure covered wet slips and dry storage for boats up to 30 feet. The marina includes a store with beverages, snacks, boating essentials, and apparel, plus a high-speed fuel station with ethanol-free fuel. The marina is open year-round and offers services to prepare boats for pickup from dry storage.
